pcc.telemetry: phased full gate with unique phase receipts, exact-version governed patch chaining, Windows-safe patch identity checks, post-apply hashes, Cargo-free Rust source/module/dependency audit, authored-scene source-rect validation, Summer mapping recovery validation, 16-mask semantic resolver-lab validation, full resolved semantic-to-recipe edge/corner + bit-orientation pipeline validation, early complete-manifest preflight + immediate full core-asset identity certification, Cargo.lock snapshot + --locked metadata verification, per-job heartbeat, active-job recovery, gate receipts, recent-log diagnostics; runtime-generation handshake prevents pre-update PCC processes from certifying post-update source; M2D082C Generated World intent/shoreline/tree regression gate; M2D082D semantic-cell/dual-grid vertex coordinate authority regression gate; M2D082F land-connectivity + extended Summer-material regression gate; M2D090 seasonal-source/purpose-population/elevation/worldgen showcase regression gate
pcc.gitPublish: Full Gate records both Git state and a Git-history-independent publishable-source fingerprint. Primary option 2 can bootstrap Git or attach the canonical shifty81/HavenwildBevy origin after certification without invalidating the gate when source bytes are unchanged. Existing unrelated remote history is adopted with git reset --mixed so current source files are preserved, then certified changes are committed onto origin/main. Machine-readable Git filename queries keep stderr separate so Windows core.autocrlf warnings cannot become staged path names. Fetch/ahead-behind checks still fail closed on behind/diverged branches, forbidden local payloads, or post-gate source edits.
pcc.mainWorkflow: 1 Full Quality Gate / certify current source; 2 Commit + Push certified source to canonical GitHub; 3 Patch scan/review/apply. Patch intake is manifest-first for root ZIPs and updates/inbox; manual extract/overwrite remains supported when followed by Full Gate.
